actions.description:
Trigger A 1st- or higher-level animal summoned by Nugrah is killed within 30 feet of him

Effect Blood- red energy flows from the slain creature into Nugrah's mouth. He immediately heals @Damage[1d6[healing]] Hit Points per level of the slain animal, gaining any excess healing as temporary Hit Points that last for 10 minutes. As long as he possesses these temporary Hit Points, blood-red energy ripples across his flesh and his AC increases to 22.
actions.name: Survival of the Fittest
actions.trigger: A 1st- or higher-level animal summoned by Nugrah is killed within 30 feet of him

actions.description:
Requirements Nugrah has a Summon Animal spell prepared and available.

Effect Nugrah casts summon animal but does not need to use a material component.
actions.name: Swift Summon
actions.requirements: Nugrah has a Summon Animal spell prepared and available.
